head: codex/113-wp18c03-roster-presence-preparation
title: [v0.92][WP-18C.03] Complete the live Polis roster and agent presence model
body:
Closes #113

## Summary
- expose policy-filtered Runtime roster pages and versioned agent detail
- authenticate page and exact-successor event cursors against Runtime policy, query, and revision
- preserve stable identity and bounded restart/reconnect behavior in the Observatory
- bound output allocation to page size under the explicit 10,000-entry local population ceiling

## Validation
- agent_roster: 15/15 PASS
- control: 25/25 PASS
- openapi_contract: 6/6 PASS
- HTML Observatory contract: PASS
- strict library and binary Clippy: PASS
- formatting and diff hygiene: PASS
- retained public-TLS managed Chrome and Guardian restart proof: PASS

## Review
- independent exact-head review of 448316bac7f0ebcffaca816b29be8c40ecfbab73: PASS with no actionable findings

## Boundaries
- distributed and non-local roster authority remains #142
- long-running distributed and soak-style validation is out of band under #226 and is not coupled to this focused PR
